description: Business screens UI improvements across all 13 files in src/features/business/. Apply consistent visual upgrades: gradient page-header accent bars, improved KPI card hover states with subtle color tinting, better empty states, chart improvements, richer card headers, sticky action bars, timeline visual polish, improved tab styling, and creator card enhancements. Also improve BusinessLayout: wider sidebar brand area, smooth hover transitions on nav items, improved bottom tab bar active indicator. All improvements use existing biz-* CSS classes plus new utility classes appended to index.css.
steps: 1. src/index.css (append new section '== BUSINESS UI ENHANCEMENTS =='): Add .biz-page-gradient-bar (4px top gradient accent on page header area, coral), .biz-kpi--highlighted (coral tint on high-value KPI cards), .biz-tab-pill (pill-style tab switcher for CampaignOperationsPage), .biz-tab-pill__btn and .biz-tab-pill__btn--active (white card on active, shadow), .biz-section-divider (1px border with 24px vertical margin), .biz-stat-strip (horizontal flex row of mini stats for campaign header), .biz-stat-strip__item (individual stat item with label/value pair), .biz-sticky-action-bar (sticky bottom bar for creator selection — white bg, border-top, padding, shadow, flex row), .biz-creator-card (full card for CreatorSelectionPage, border, radius 16, overflow hidden, transition), .biz-creator-card--selected (coral border + ring shadow), .biz-timeline-dot--current (pulse ring animation for current timeline event), .biz-neg-log (chat-style negotiation log container), .biz-neg-log__msg (individual message bubble, flex row with avatar+text), .biz-neg-log__avatar--ai (coral gradient for AI), .biz-neg-log__avatar--creator (peach for creator). For mobile (<=480px): .biz-stat-strip should flex-wrap, .biz-kpi__value font-size shrinks.

2. src/features/business/BusinessLayout.tsx: Add a colored indicator line under the active sidebar nav item — change .biz-nav__item--active to include a 3px left border in coral (via inline style or add a new CSS class .biz-nav__item--active-bar). Improve the brand section: add a subtle gradient background to .biz-sidebar__brand div (rgba coral tint). In the mobile bottom bar, add a background dot indicator above active icon (already in CSS as .biz-bottom-nav__item--active .biz-bottom-nav__icon-wrap). Add aria-label='Business navigation' to bottom <nav>. No logic changes.

3. src/features/business/BusinessDashboard.tsx: Wrap the page in a div with a subtle top accent — add a .biz-page-gradient-bar <div> as first child inside <BusinessLayout>. Update the AI banner to use the biz-ai-banner class more prominently (already used — ensure it has the pulsing dot). Upgrade KPI cards: add a small sparkline trend indicator (a simple inline SVG arrow icon) next to delta values. Improve campaign list items: increase border-radius to 14px, add a left-border color accent (3px coral for active, blue for draft, orange for pending) using inline style. Pending approval items: add a colored left border matching the type (content=coral, counter=orange).

4. src/features/business/CampaignListPage.tsx: Upgrade each campaign card to show a colored status bar on the left side (3px left border, color matches status). Add an icon prefix to platform labels (📷 for Instagram, 📺 for YouTube). Add a small 'Fill' percentage badge styled with .biz-score class next to budget. Improve the empty state with a larger icon container (48px circle with bg-coral-10) and a primary CTA button.

5. src/features/business/CreateCampaignPage.tsx: Style the mode toggle (AI vs Manual) as a proper pill tab using the new .biz-tab-pill / .biz-tab-pill__btn classes. In the brief step, add a character count display using a pill (bottom-right of textarea, already exists — improve to show bg-coral when under 50 chars). In the review step, improve field rows: add alternating row background (even rows: --in-cream). In the strategy step, add a checkmark circle overlay on the selected strategy card's top-right corner. Improve strategy grid: on mobile (<=599px) it should be 1 column.

6. src/features/business/CreatorSelectionPage.tsx: Replace inline card div with .biz-creator-card and .biz-creator-card--selected classes. The sticky selection summary bar at top: use new .biz-sticky-action-bar class. FitBadge component: keep existing inline style but add a title attribute with the score description. Expanded detail section: improve the 'why this creator fits' box to use biz-ai-banner styling. On mobile (<=600px), the stats row should stack (currently it flex-wraps — ensure minWidth 0 on stat items and remove fixed minWidth:64 for mobile).

7. src/features/business/GuardrailsPage.tsx: Improve input wrappers — add focus ring using the same .in-input-wrap style (currently using raw inline styles; switch to consistent .biz-guardrail-input class added to index.css: same look as in-input-wrap but with ₹ prefix span). The AI negotiation enabled block: use biz-ai-banner styling instead of a raw div. Guardrail summary section: use .biz-stat-strip class for the tag list.

8. src/features/business/InvitationsPage.tsx: Negotiation log (showNegLog): wrap each message in .biz-neg-log__msg with .biz-neg-log__avatar--ai or .biz-neg-log__avatar--creator. Summary chips at top: use .biz-pill equivalents instead of raw inline spans. Mobile card list and desktop table are already using correct classes — no changes needed there.

9. src/features/business/CampaignOperationsPage.tsx: Replace raw inline tab switcher divs with .biz-tab-pill / .biz-tab-pill__btn classes. Budget summary mini-stat row: use .biz-stat-strip / .biz-stat-strip__item classes. Timeline dots: current dot gets .biz-timeline-dot--current class (adds pulse ring). Individual creator rows in Creators tab: each should use .biz-creator-card (without selection checkbox variant) for consistent styling.

10. src/features/business/ApprovalsPage.tsx: Item selector buttons: convert to .biz-tab-pill style. Video placeholder: improve mock to a more polished 9:16 frame with a gradient overlay and play button icon (all CSS, no images). AI score circle badge: already styled inline — add aria-label='AI compliance score: {score}'. Feedback textarea: apply .in-input-wrap focus styles (add .biz-textarea class to index.css: same border/bg/focus as in-input-wrap but for textarea).

11. src/features/business/AnalyticsPage.tsx: Bar chart: improve bar rendering — on hover, bars should highlight (add onMouseEnter/Leave for opacity change). Add a chart legend row below. Creator performance mobile cards: improve grid to show all 6 stats in a consistent 2-col grid. AI optimization recommendation items: already using correct classes.

12. src/features/business/PaymentsPage.tsx: The payments table is desktop-only — add a mobile card list (biz-cardlist / biz-cardlist-item) for the payments data visible on screens <=699px (same pattern as InvitationsPage). KPI summary uses biz-kpi-grid — already correct. Add a payments security notice styled as biz-ai-banner at the bottom.

13. src/features/business/NotificationsPage.tsx: Notification items: already well styled. Improve unread indicator: change the 8px dot to a styled pill 'New' badge using biz-pill--danger class. Add a 'Filter' chip row (All, Unread, Read) using .biz-chips / .biz-chip above the notification list.

14. src/features/business/SettingsPage.tsx: Tab row: convert to .biz-tab-pill / .biz-tab-pill__btn pattern for consistency. Input fields: extract to a consistent .biz-field-input class in index.css (height 46, border-radius 10, border coral-20, focus ring). Logo placeholder: improve the square from emoji-only to a styled upload zone. Save success notification: use a toast-style absolutely positioned notification (simple absolutely positioned div that fades in/out, no external lib needed).
